title: Numerals 10: Large Numbers (сорок, девяносто, сто, тысяча, миллион)
titleRussian: Числительные 10: большие числа (сорок, девяносто, сто, тысяча, миллион)
description: The big-number anomalies: the flat сорок/девяносто/сто (two forms only) and the noun-like тысяча/миллион, which force the genitive plural on the following noun in every case.
descriptionRussian: Особенности больших чисел: «плоские» сорок/девяносто/сто (всего две формы) и существительные-числительные тысяча/миллион, которые во всех падежах требуют после себя родительного множественного.
intro: Three numbers are lazy: forty, ninety and a hundred have only two forms each, so every oblique case is the same word. Thousand and million are not really numbers at all but nouns, which means they decline like nouns and force the genitive plural on whatever follows in every case, even the nominative. They also obey the counting rule themselves.
rules: Сорок, девяносто, and сто have only two case forms each: the nominative-accusative сорок / девяносто / сто, and a single non-nominative form сорока / девяноста / ста that covers every other case.
There is no separate dative, instrumental, or prepositional form for these three: с сорока, к девяноста, о ста all use that one non-nominative shape.
Тысяча and миллион are nouns. Тысяча declines like a feminine noun (тысячи, тысяче, тысячей); миллион like a masculine noun (миллиона, миллиону, миллионом).
Тысяча and миллион force the genitive plural on the following noun in every case, even the nominative: тысяча рублей, миллион книг.
Тысяча and миллион themselves follow the 1 / 2-4 / 5+ rule: одна тысяча, две тысячи, пять тысяч; один миллион, два миллиона, пять миллионов.
examples: Маша рассказала о сорока студентах. (Masha told us about forty students.) Non-nom сорока + prepositional plural.
К девяноста годам он многое забыл. (By ninety he had forgotten a lot.) Dative девяноста + dative plural годам.
Это книга о ста городах. (This is a book about a hundred cities.) Prepositional ста + prepositional plural.
В классе тысяча книг. (There are a thousand books in the classroom.) Тысяча forces the genitive plural книг.
Город насчитывает миллион жителей. (The city has a million inhabitants.) Миллион forces the genitive plural жителей.
В зале было две тысячи зрителей. (There were two thousand spectators in the hall.) Две тысячи (2-4 rule on тысяча) + genitive plural зрителей.

items.promptEnglish: Masha told us about forty students.
items.hint: Сорок has only two forms. Which one fits after о?
items.explanation: Сорок has exactly two shapes: the nominative-accusative сорок and a single non-nominative form сорока for every other case. О takes the prepositional, so: о сорока студентах. Сорокам and сороками do not exist in modern Russian.

items.prompt: К _____ годам он уже многое забыл.
items.promptEnglish: By ninety he had already forgotten a lot.
items.hint: К + dative. Девяносто has only two forms.
items.explanation: Девяносто works like сорок and сто: two forms total. The nominative-accusative is девяносто; everything else is девяноста. After к (dative): к девяноста годам, with the noun in the dative plural.

items.promptEnglish: Our city has a million inhabitants.
items.hint: Миллион is a noun and stands here as the nominative subject.
items.explanation: Миллион is a noun-like numeral. As the subject ('a million inhabitants'), it stands in the nominative singular миллион. The following noun жителей is genitive plural, because миллион (and тысяча) always force the genitive plural on the noun after them.

items.promptEnglish: There aren't even a hundred roubles in the wallet.
items.hint: Нет governs the genitive - a case other than the nominative.
items.explanation: Сто has only two forms: the nominative-accusative сто and a single non-nominative form ста for all other cases. Нет takes the genitive, so: нет ста рублей. Стам does not exist.

items.promptEnglish: There were a thousand spectators in the stadium.
items.hint: The subject 'a thousand ... were there' stands in the nominative; the verb agrees with тысяча.
items.explanation: Тысяча is a feminine noun. As the subject it stands in the nominative singular тысяча, and the verb agrees with it: была тысяча. The counted noun goes into the genitive plural: тысяча зрителей. Тысяч is the genitive plural (after 5+: пять тысяч).

items.promptEnglish: Two thousand people were sitting in the hall.
items.hint: Тысяча obeys the number rule itself: what follows две?
items.explanation: Тысяча is counted like any noun, so после две it takes the genitive singular: две тысячи. (Then тысячи forces человек into its own genitive-plural count form.) Тысяч is the genitive plural for 5+ (пять тысяч), and тысячу is the accusative singular.

blanks: Библиотека получила около _____ новых книг. (The library received about a hundred new books.)
В городе живёт почти _____ человек. (Almost a million people live in the city.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: (1) Около governs the genitive, a case other than the nominative, so сто becomes ста: около ста книг. (2) Миллион here is the nominative subject-quantity, so it stays миллион and forces the genitive plural человек.
hints: Около takes the genitive. Which of the two forms of сто fits?
The quantity stands in the nominative here; which is the dictionary form?

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The city has more than a million residents.
errorCorrection.explanation: Миллион declines like an ordinary masculine noun, unlike the flat numerals сорок / девяносто / сто. Больше governs the genitive, so the form is миллиона: больше миллиона жителей. Миллиону is the dative and миллионом the instrumental.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон приехал с тысяча рублей в кармане.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton arrived with a thousand rubles in his pocket.
errorCorrection.explanation: Тысяча declines like an ordinary feminine noun, not like the flat numerals. С takes the instrumental, so the form is тысячей: с тысячей рублей. Тысячу is the accusative and тысяче the dative-prepositional.

errorCorrection.sentence: В библиотеке тысяча книг лежат на полках.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: A thousand books in the library lie on the shelves.
errorCorrection.explanation: Тысяча is a feminine singular noun, so the verb agrees with it in the singular: тысяча книг лежит. The plural лежат is the trap, pulled in by the plural-feeling 'books'. The counted noun книг stays in the genitive plural, but it is тысяча that controls the verb, hence the singular лежит (or in the past, лежала).

errorCorrection.sentence: В концерте участвовали два миллиона зрители.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Two million spectators took part in the concert.
errorCorrection.explanation: Миллион forces the genitive plural on the following noun in every context: миллион зрителей, два миллиона зрителей. Зрители is the nominative plural, the trap of leaving the noun unchanged. Note also that два миллиона follows the 2-4 rule on миллион itself (genitive singular миллиона), while зрителей stays genitive plural because that is what миллион always demands.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The book tells about a hundred cities.
minimalPairs.explanation: О takes a non-nominative case, and сто has just one non-nominative form: ста. So о ста городах. Сто is the nominative-accusative form, wrong after о.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: A million people live in the city.
minimalPairs.explanation: As the nominative subject-quantity, the form is миллион, which forces the genitive plural человек: миллион человек. Миллионов is the genitive plural of миллион itself, used after 5+ (пять миллионов), not here.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Masha was speaking with forty students.
sentenceBuilding.hint: с takes the instrumental; сорок has one non-nominative form (сорока).

sentenceBuilding.translation: There are about a hundred pages in the book.
sentenceBuilding.hint: около takes the genitive, so сто becomes ста and страница becomes the genitive plural.

sentenceBuilding.translation: There were a thousand spectators in the hall.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Тысяча is the nominative subject and forces the genitive plural зрителей; the verb agrees with тысяча (была).

sentenceBuilding.translation: The city spent two million roubles.
sentenceBuilding.hint: два + genitive singular миллиона; рублей stays genitive plural because миллион demands it.

patternRecognition.question: Why is the form девяноста here?
options: It is the single non-nominative form, used for every case but nom-acc
It is the genitive plural of девяносто
It is a spelling variant of девяносто
patternRecognition.answer: It is the single non-nominative form, used for every case but nom-acc
patternRecognition.explanation: Девяносто (like сорок and сто) has only two forms: the nominative-accusative девяносто and one non-nominative form девяноста that covers the genitive, dative, instrumental, and prepositional. С takes the instrumental, so: с девяноста студентами.

patternRecognition.question: Why is человек in the genitive plural?
options: Тысяча is a noun that forces the genitive plural on the following noun
тысяча is in the genitive, so человек agrees
patternRecognition.answer: Тысяча is a noun that forces the genitive plural on the following noun
patternRecognition.explanation: Тысяча behaves like a noun and, like the quantity words 5+, forces the following noun into the genitive plural, even when тысяча itself is the nominative subject: тысяча человек. The verb agrees with тысяча (живёт, singular).

patternRecognition.sentence: В зале было три тысячи зрителей.
patternRecognition.question: Why is the form тысячи after три?
options: Тысяча obeys the 2-4 rule itself, taking the genitive singular
тысячи is the nominative plural subject
It is an irregular numeral form
patternRecognition.answer: Тысяча obeys the 2-4 rule itself, taking the genitive singular
patternRecognition.explanation: Тысяча is counted like any noun, so after три (the 2-4 slot) it takes the genitive singular: три тысячи. Then тысячи forces зрителей into the genitive plural. Тысяч would be the genitive plural after 5+ (пять тысяч).

reviewVocab.definition: forty / ninety / one hundred. Only two case forms each: nom-acc сорок / девяносто / сто, and a single non-nominative form сорока / девяноста / ста for all other cases.
reviewVocab.example: К девяноста годам, о ста городах, с сорока студентами.

reviewVocab.definition: thousand / million. Decline as feminine / masculine nouns and force the genitive plural on the following noun in every case.
reviewVocab.example: Тысяча рублей, миллион книг, к миллиону зрителей.

reviewVocab.term: одна тысяча, две тысячи, пять тысяч
reviewVocab.definition: тысяча and миллион obey the 1 / 2-4 / 5+ rule themselves when counted, like any noun.
reviewVocab.example: Одна тысяча, две тысячи, пять тысяч; один миллион, два миллиона, пять миллионов.
